name: Camping Erlebnis Zugspitze
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Erlebnis Zugspitze is located in Garmisch-Partenkirchen near the border with Tirol. It is situated at the foot of the Zugspitze and is surrounded by the mountain world of the Bayerischen Alpen. The surrounding area offers access to numerous hiking trails and ski areas such as Garmisch-Classic. The atmosphere at the campsite is quiet and family-friendly. The amenities include sanitary facilities, electrical connections, a restaurant, and a playground. Guests can expect well-maintained pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents. The campsite is a suitable starting point for outdoor activities.
